queries.query:
SELECT snapshot_date FROM dmv_snapshots
        WHERE snapshot_date >= ? AND snapshot_date <= ? AND snapshot_date > (SELECT MIN(snapshot_date) FROM dmv_snapshots)

SELECT MIN(o.observed_at) AS first,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.observed_at >= ? AND o.observed_at < ?), 0) AS previous,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.observed_at >= ? AND o.observed_at < ?), 0) AS today
        FROM submissions s JOIN vehicle_observations o ON o.submission_id = s.id
        LEFT JOIN robotaxi_vehicles pv ON pv.id = o.robotaxi_vehicle_id AND pv.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = pv.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (pv.origin = 'sighting' AND ((pv.vin IS NOT NULL AND pv.vin <> '')
                                          OR pv.approval_basis IS NOT NULL)))
        WHERE 
  s.submission_type = 'vehicle_sighting' AND s.status = 'approved' AND s.evidence_type = 'photo'
  AND o.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND o.public_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.submitted_at > datetime('now', '-30 days') AND (o.robotaxi_vehicle_id IS NULL OR pv.id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT MIN(observed_at) AS first FROM camera_detections

SELECT v.id, v.license_plate, v.vin, v.created_at FROM robotaxi_vehicles v WHERE v.visibility = 'public' AND (EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trips t JOIN submissions s ON s.id = t.submission_id
    WHERE t.robotaxi_vehicle_id = v.id AND t.superseded_by IS NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'approved')
  )
    OR (v.origin = 'sighting' AND ((v.vin IS NOT NULL AND v.vin <> '')
                                          OR v.approval_basis IS NOT NULL))) AND (lower(trim(v.model)) = 'cybercab' OR v.approval_basis IS NOT NULL) AND lower(trim(COALESCE(v.model, ''))) NOT IN ('model y', 'model_y', 'modely')
SELECT observed_at FROM camera_detections WHERE observed_at >= ? AND observed_at < ?

SELECT first_seen_date AS date, lower(model) AS model, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dmv_av_vehicles
        WHERE first_seen_date >= ? AND first_seen_date <= ? AND in_baseline = 0 AND lower(model) IN ('cybercab', 'model y') GROUP BY first_seen_date, lower(model)
